name: plugin.rea_native
description: REA native binary reverse engineering: Ghidra/Hopper/IDA decompilation, call graphs, pwntools ELF layout, WABT 1.0.42 WASM inspection, and EVM interface parsing.

entrypoints.name: rea_native_batch_decompile
entrypoints.description: Decompile one or more procedure symbols concurrently via headless Ghidra, Hopper, or IDA.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: List of procedure symbol names to decompile

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Decompiler provider: ghidra, hopper, or ida

entrypoints.name: rea_native_call_graph
entrypoints.description: Traverse caller or callee relationships from a procedure entrypoint.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction of traversal: callee or caller

entrypoints.name: rea_native_elf_layout
entrypoints.description: Offline static binary inspection via pwntools: section map, imported/exported symbols, and exploit mitigations (checksec).

parameters.name: checksec
parameters.description: Whether to check binary exploit mitigations

entrypoints.name: rea_native_wasm_inspect
entrypoints.description: Validate and inspect WebAssembly binaries via WABT 1.0.42: sections, imports/exports, and optional WAT disassembly.

entrypoints.name: rea_native_evm_interface
entrypoints.description: Parse flat EVM bytecode, extract 4-byte dispatch selectors, disassemble opcodes, and resolve public ABI signatures.

parameters.name: resolve_signatures
parameters.description: Whether to resolve 4-byte selectors to known function signatures

entrypoints.name: rea_native_annotate_function
entrypoints.description: Atomically update a function name and/or entry comment in the Ghidra session database.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Function entrypoint address in hex or decimal

entrypoints.name: rea_native_inspect_load_image
entrypoints.description: Verify a loaded DOS MZ or COM image against its immutable target snapshot: byte digests, header mappings, and relocations.

parameters.name: target_path
parameters.description: Path to DOS MZ/COM binary target
